hint.attention: No significant effect on safety. Vehicle passes; repair when convenient.
hint.fail: May prejudice safety or affect the environment. Vehicle fails; repair and retest.
hint.dangerous: Direct and immediate risk to road safety. The vehicle must not be driven.
hint.not_inspected: This check has not been carried out.
hint.not_applicable: The vehicle has no such part, so there was nothing to test.

detail.pass_minor: The vehicle passes. Repair the minor deficiencies without undue delay.
detail.fail: The vehicle fails. The deficiencies must be repaired and the vehicle retested.
detail.fail_dangerous: The vehicle must not be used on the public road until the dangerous deficiencies are repaired.
detail.incomplete: The inspection is still in progress.

page.workOrderRaised: Work order {number} raised from this inspection on {date}
page.quoteRequested: The customer asked for a quote on {count} item(s)
page.progressLabel: {graded} of {total} checks graded: {pass} no defect, {attention} minor, {fail} major, {dangerous} dangerous.
page.scaleEu: Graded on the EU defect scale from Directive 2014/45/EU.
page.completeBody: The checks are locked once the inspection is completed, and the result becomes "{result}".
page.completeBlocked: {count} check(s) the checklist marks as mandatory are outstanding.
page.completeDangerous: {count} dangerous defect(s) recorded. The vehicle must not be used on the public road.
page.reopenBody: The checks become editable again and the result goes back to in progress. The inspector, certificate number and next test date are kept.
page.reopenShared: The customer's link stays live and will show the result changing as you edit. Any certificate already downloaded keeps the old result.
page.deleteBody: This permanently deletes the inspection, its grades, notes and photos. It cannot be undone.
page.workOrderDefectsTitle: {count, plural, one {Add the item that needs attention?} other {Add the # items that need attention?}}
page.workOrderDefectsBody: Each one becomes a line on the work order, with the technician's note, after the line for the inspection.
page.raisedFromInspection: Raised from the inspection carried out on {date}.
page.nextStepWorkOrderHint: Put the repairs, or just the inspection, on a job for the board.
page.nextStepQuoteHint: Price the defects for the customer to approve first.
page.linkWorkOrderBody: Create a new job, or link the inspection to one already booked for this car.
page.createNewWorkOrderHint: A new job for this car, numbered and put on the board.
page.noOpenWorkOrders: No open jobs for this vehicle.
page.notesHint: Printed on the certificate and shown to the customer.
page.notesPlaceholder: Anything the customer should know beyond the graded checks…
page.quoteRequestMissingChecks: {count} requested check(s) are no longer on the checklist.
page.quoteFromRequestNote: Raised from the customer's quote request on the inspection link.

item.addPhoto: Add a photo or video to {name}
item.describeDefect: Describe the defect — this appears on the report
item.notesRequired: Describe the defect before this grade is saved.
item.photoRequired: A photo of the defect is required here. The inspection cannot be completed until one is attached.
item.clearBody: The note recorded against "{name}" will be removed and the check goes back to not inspected.
item.reopenToChange: Reopen the inspection to add photos
item.tapToClear: Tap again to clear the grade

certificate.title: Certificate details
certificate.description: Required on a roadworthiness certificate under Directive 2014/45/EU, Annex IV.
certificate.reportReferenceHelp: Your own reference for this report. If you are an approved test centre issuing a national control slip, put its number here so the two match. Otherwise leave it empty.
certificate.intervalGroup: Set the next test date from the date of this test
certificate.intervalHelp: Counted from the date of this test. Two years is the Union baseline for cars and light goods vehicles; check the interval your country applies.
certificate.saveFailed: Could not save the certificate details
certificate.addTechnicianBody: They join the workshop roster and can be assigned work as well as inspections.
certificate.savesAsYouGo: Details save as you fill them in

templates.title: Inspection checklists
templates.description: The checklists your technicians work through. Build one per country, per vehicle type or per service you sell.
templates.restoreBanner: {count} ready-made checklist(s) have been removed from your list. You can put them back.
templates.translateBanner: Your ready-made checklists are in {from}. Translate them to {to}? Checks you have renamed stay as they are.
templates.emptyBody: The ready-made checklists — including the EU periodic technical inspection — have all been removed. Put them back, or build your own from scratch.
templates.deleteBody: This permanently deletes the checklist. Inspections already carried out with it keep their own copy and are not affected.

presets.title: Start from a ready-made checklist
presets.description: Every preset is copied into your workshop as a normal checklist. Rename sections, move checks and change any limit to match your country and your equipment.
presets.search: Search by name, country or standard
presets.warning: Regulatory presets carry the common EU limits. Check them against your national rules before you issue a certificate.
presets.added: Checklist added. Adjust it to match your workshop.

groupDescription.regulatory: Periodic technical inspection checklists built on Directive 2014/45/EU.
groupDescription.workshop: General service and sales checklists that are not tied to a regulation.
groupDescription.specialist: Checklists for drivetrains and vessels that need their own procedure.

builder.description: Build the checklist your workshop actually uses. Drag to reorder, and configure each check to record a grade, a measurement, a written note or a fixed answer.
builder.name: Name
builder.descriptionPlaceholder: What this checklist is for and when to use it.
builder.countryHelp: Recorded on the report so a shop working across borders can tell its checklists apart.
builder.scaleEuHelp: The categories in Article 7(2) of Directive 2014/45/EU. A vehicle with only minor defects still passes.
builder.scaleBasicHelp: A plain three-step scale for service checklists that are not a statutory test.
builder.defaultHelp: Pre-selected when a technician starts a new inspection.
builder.renumberHelp: Numbers every section and check in order — 1, 1.1, 1.2, 2. New rows are numbered as you add them, so you only need this after moving things about.
builder.renumberWarning: This checklist uses regulation references such as 1.1.13. Renumbering replaces them.
builder.sectionNote: Optional note shown above the checks in this section
builder.checkName: Check name, e.g. Brake linings and pads
builder.guidancePlaceholder: Shown under the check name on the inspection form.
builder.rangeHelp: Leave a bound empty for a one-sided limit, e.g. a minimum of 1.6 mm with no maximum. Readings outside the range are graded automatically.
builder.photoRequired: Photo required when a defect is recorded
builder.commonWordingHelp: One phrase per line. These are offered first when a technician records a defect here, ahead of the built-in wording, so your shop can settle on how it describes a fault.

inputHint.condition: Technician grades the check against the defect scale.
inputHint.measurement: Records a number in a unit, graded automatically against a range.
inputHint.text: Records a written observation, e.g. a tyre brand or a fault code.
inputHint.choice: Technician picks one of a fixed list of answers.

packages.exportDescription: Downloads the whole checklist as a file — sections, checks, units and limits. Anyone running Torqvoice can import it.
packages.includeWordingHelp: The phrases your workshop added to checks. Useful to whoever receives this, but they are free text typed at a bench and can name a customer, a colleague or a local arrangement. Off unless you have read them.
packages.attributeHelp: Written into the file so whoever installs it can see where it came from. Nothing is taken from your account.
packages.importDescription: Adds a checklist from a Torqvoice package file. It arrives as a normal checklist you can edit, and never replaces one you already have.
packages.unreadable: That file could not be read. A Torqvoice package is a .json file exported from a checklist.
packages.limitsWarning: Limits in a shared checklist are whatever its author set. Check them against your national rules before issuing anything from it.

shareDialog.title: Share Inspection
shareDialog.description: Share a read-only view of this inspection with your customer.

phone.wholeBody: Overview photos, and documents such as the signed inspection form.
phone.checksBody: Tap a check to photograph it. The photo appears next to its grade.
phone.checksClosed: This inspection is completed, so its checks take no more photos. You can still add to the whole inspection.
phone.completedError: This inspection was completed. Ask at the desk to reopen it.
phone.limitError: This check or inspection already holds as many photos as it can.
phone.invalid: Scan the code on the inspection again.
phone.dialogBody: Photograph each check where it is, or add overview photos and documents to the whole inspection. Everything lands straight on this inspection.
phone.step2: Pick a check on the phone and take the photo, or add to the whole inspection.
phone.step3: They appear on this inspection as they arrive.
phone.scope: The link only adds photos and documents to this inspection, and stops working after 30 minutes.
phone.dialogTitleItem: Add photos of {name} from a phone
phone.dialogBodyItem: Photograph this check where it is. The photo lands next to its grade; the phone can add to the other checks too.
phone.stepItem2: Take the photo on the phone; it goes on this check.
phone.focusTitle: The check this code was shown for

files.title: Photos and documents
files.hint: For the inspection as a whole. A photo of one check belongs on that check.
